annotations.title: Export an edit to CapCut, Premiere, Resolve or Final Cut

description: Turn an edit into projects that open in CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve and Final Cut Pro, with captions and titles as each editor's own editable text. Pass a CutConvert Edit JSON document in `edit` and 1 to 4 editors in `targets`. Returns a zip as an embedded resource (application/zip): a folder for each editor and report.json, plus a short text with the warnings and the exports left. The tool sends no media. Each project points to the files at their `path` in the document; a file without a path opens offline, ready to relink. Each call is one export of the Edit API's allowance: 3 a month per network without a key, or an API key's 10 free a month and its packs when the MCP client sends "Authorization: Bearer cck_…". Edit JSON: times are seconds, positions are fractions of the frame, and unknown fields are errors. Every field: https://cutconvert.com/developers/edit-json (JSON Schema: https://cutconvert.com/developers/edit-json/schema.json). A small document: {"cutconvert":"edit/1","name":"My edit","timeline":{"fps":25,"width":1920,"height":1080},"media":[{"id":"a","name":"a.mp4","path":"/Users/sam/Movies/a.mp4","duration":30,"fps":25,"width":1920,"height":1080,"audio":{"streams":[2],"sampleRate":48000}}],"video":[{"clips":[{"media":"a","start":0,"in":2,"out":12}]}],"captions":{"items":[{"start":0.5,"end":3,"text":"Hello"}]}}

edit.description: The CutConvert Edit JSON document (version 1), as an object or as a string holding it. At most 8 MB.

targets.description: The editors to export for, each once: capcut (a CapCut desktop project folder), premiere (Premiere Pro XML), resolve (a DaVinci Resolve .drp project), finalcut (Final Cut Pro FCPXML).
